title: EPSRC CDT MRes + PhD in Photonic and Electronic Systems
about: Four-year EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training MRes + PhD in Photonic and Electronic Systems, run by the University of Cambridge with UCL, starting 1 October 2027. The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026; the general application deadline is 13 May 2027.
requirements: Four-year programme: an initial MRes year followed by a three-year PhD, run with University College London (UCL)
